answer: By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The atlas lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the dawn is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
